blocks.text: The PMPC Star Awards Inc. announced the contenders for the 42nd Star Awards for Movies, with “Quezon,” “I’mPerfect,” Vice Ganda and Maricel Soriano, among others, leading the nominations. “Quezon” and “I’mPerfect” both vie for the Movie of the Year honor, along with “Bar Boys: After School,” “Call Me Mother,” “Manila’s Finest,” “The Delivery Rider,” and “Unmarry.” Vice Ganda is among the Movie Actor of the Year nominees, bagging the nomination for her portrayal in “Call Me Mother.” Also contending for the award are JM De Guzman (“Lasting Moments”), Joshua Garcia (“Meet Greet Bye”), Baron Geisler ( “The Delivery Rider”), Piolo Pascual […]...
